rows.jyutping: sik1 gong2 loeng5 zung2 jyu5 jin4
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken way to describe someone who can speak two languages.

example.english: I’m bilingual, so I can communicate with foreign customers.
example.traditional: 我識講兩種語言，可以同外國客人溝通。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik1 gong2 loeng5 zung2 jyu5 jin4 ho2 ji5 tung4 ngoi6 gwok3 haak3 jan4 kau1 tung1

rows.note: Use this concise term for things presented or conducted in two languages.

example.english: The station provides bilingual service to make things easier for tourists.
example.traditional: 車站提供雙語服務，方便遊客。
example.jyutping: ce1 zaam6 tai4 gung1 soeng1 jyu5 fuk6 mou6 fong1 bin6 jau4 haak3
